    if not cells:
        return out
    rmin = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    rmax = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    cmin = min(c for _, c in cells)
    cmax = max(c for _, c in cells)

    if marker_col is not None:

    if marker_col is not None:
        # The pattern is copied to the other side of a center divider, toward
        # the 2 marker. The divider column is the midpoint of the width.
        axis = w // 2
        marker_right = marker_col > axis
        if cells:
            cmin = min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
            cmax = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
            if marker_right and cmax < axis:
                shift = 2 * axis - cmax - cmin
                for r, c, _ in cells:
                    out[r][c] = background
                for r, c, color in cells:
                    out[r][c + shift] = color
            elif not marker_right and cmin > axis:
                shift = 2 * axis - cmax - cmin
                for r, c, _ in cells:
                    out[r][c] = background
                for r, c, color in cells:
                    out[r][c + shift] = color
        for r in range(h):
            if grid[r][axis] != 2:
                out[r][axis] = 8

    elif marker_row is not None:
        # Horizontal analogue: midpoint row divider, shift the object across
        # it toward the full 2 stripe.
        axis = h // 2
        marker_below = marker_row > axis
        if cells:
            rmin = min(r for r, _, _ in cells)
            rmax = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
            if marker_below and rmax < axis:
                shift = 2 * axis - rmax - rmin
                for r, c, _ in cells:
                    out[r][c] = background
                for r, c, color in cells:
                    out[r + shift][c] = color
            elif not marker_below and rmin > axis:
                shift = 2 * axis - rmax - rmin
                for r, c, _ in cells:
                    out[r][c] = background
                for r, c, color in cells:
                    out[r + shift][c] = color
        out[axis] = [2 if v == 2 else 8 for v in grid[axis]]
    return out
